findings.description: The project schedule contains no baseline_start or baseline_finish fields despite the Charter defining them as required.

evidence.quote_or_absence: Field 'baseline_start' is null across all rows

standard_reference.summary: A schedule baseline must be established and approved

findings.impact: Inability to measure schedule variance prevents accurate forecasting
findings.recommended_action: Establish and approve schedule baseline before next reporting period

intelligence_indicators.visibility: Project status is partially visible but baseline absence creates blind spots for variance tracking.
intelligence_indicators.integrity: Schedule data exists but cannot be trusted for performance measurement without baseline.
intelligence_indicators.governance: Governance packs are produced but lack baseline approval evidence.
intelligence_indicators.predictability: Severely degraded due to missing baseline — forecast accuracy is unmeasurable.
intelligence_indicators.decision_quality: Decisions are made without earned value data, reducing evidence basis.
intelligence_indicators.continuous_improvement: No evidence of lessons learned feeding into schedule planning.
